notes_for_editor: Two independent-looking sources agree on the 1962 move to a new tower about a mile south (directory) and on a south-summit tower in 1962 (firelookout.com); the 1935 build date rests on firelookout.com alone. Record coordinates 42.3664, -123.6571 sit about 1.7 km north of firelookout.com's map pin at 42.35097, -123.65936; the pin may mark the south summit, so the record point is worth checking. The directory also lists a Serpentine Mountain - 2 entry (Siskiyou NF), not checked here. Firelookout.com gives elevations of 4282 ft and 4492 ft for the two summits; not used. Southern Oregon University holds a 1994 Forest Service report on eight Siskiyou lookouts built 1945-1963 (Kay Atwood Collection, MSS-025, box 13, folder 01). Its catalog does not name them, so it is not tied to this site. The directory says removed and firelookout.com says ruins; the story reports both without reconciling them.
